close_reason: Added explanatory comment in both handle_email_get and handle_email_parse
description: In handle_email_get and handle_email_parse, when the client requests header:<Name> properties but does NOT explicitly request 'headers', the code injects 'headers' into the effective property set so the backend returns it, extracts the dynamic values from it, then removes it from the response object (need_headers_injected flag). A future contributor might remove this 'inject then strip' dance as overly complex, but it is correct and necessary: without it, header: properties would silently return null for all emails because the raw headers array would never be fetched from the backend.
title: header: property injection: keep 'headers' in backend pass, remove before returning if client didn't ask for it
